studies.title: The World Wide Web
studies.caption: Tim Berners-Lee at CERN publishes the first website: documents linked across the internet that anyone can read and write.
studies.prompt: Quiet close office view at CERN1991: black cubic NeXT workstation beside a square deep CRT monitor, black keyboard and wired mouse, early text-only browser window represented by small illegible lines. Papers and desk cables, no laptop, smartphone, colorful modern browser or readable labels.
